connection_audit.mechanical_audit: Parsed actual generated declarations and literal DUT connections; all names, widths, directions at wrapper boundary, all nine port field names, port monitor indices, page-base slots and read/write intervals match the accepted mapping. Both Lite masters bind their exact bank and widths. Global pins are clock, active-low reset and interrupt.
connection_audit.initialization: Cold backing pages are external fixture bytes. Every fresh runtime cwd binds all 108 generated DAT files by absolute symlink; no internal force, deposit or owner preload.

protocol_review.adapter: One owned register per channel; upstream acceptance and downstream delivery are distinct legal handshakes, with held payload, monotone ownership counts and stable visible VALID. Exact DUT-side and endpoint-side monitors and drain comparison prevent any accepted beat from being discarded or duplicated.
protocol_review.queue_bound: Endpoint has AW/AR/B descriptor queues of four, W queue of 64, one R slot; adapters add one slot each. Monitor Q=16 covers the finite AW/B and AR/R debt, WQ=80 covers endpoint64 plus adapter and same-edge bookkeeping without a single-outstanding assumption.
protocol_review.done: Generated top ap_done is combinational. TB samples it at posedge using NBA and checks all monitor/adapter debts at the following negedge, after the same edge has retired responses; never delays checking to a later drain. CSR done/idle also checked.
protocol_review.stalls: Fixed seed 0..3 exposure delays on all channels. Legal command3 captures final activation R index16 at negedge with 960 prior bytes. Final out0 B chosen only after8 useful bytes and exactly one AW-B debt. Each gets additional16 cycles, actual wait>=16 asserted, selected index and wait logged.
protocol_review.monitor: Both sides check full 64-bit range, aligned INCR burst <=16beats/no4KiB crossing, IDs, response, LAST, strobe lanes, unknowns and independent bus/useful byte counts. W may arrive before AW.

functional_review.comparison: Per command all256 observed header words, all131072 observed bytes, all4096 out0/out1 bytes and every input backing page are compared before overwrite. Frozen byte-exact q/half-scale/selected-group trace/bias/final gold is retained. All nine expected wire byte totals and forbidden transactions checked.
functional_review.warm_reset: Same DUT instance, quiescent hardware reset for at least5 full clocks; pointer halves read zero then reprogrammed. Actual generated write ports identify nonzero written samples. One256-bit W cell dut.wq_U.ram, one256-bit A8 cell dut.aq_U.ram, one32-bit FP input cell dut.fp_U.ram are read and retained across reset, with addresses/values logged. Four external observed bytes also retained. No dynamic PS RAM or all-address retention claim; the separately accepted50-payload-RAM no-reset-clear structural review remains independent.
functional_review.conditional_recovery: First post-reset RUN rejects with zero claims/loads/reuses and INVALID states; new identity LOAD/RUN must complete on original numerical gold.

packet_basis.basis: ACT fixed fixture K=256,N=2,rows=1,G=8,T=1: rejected command reads 128 descriptor beats and writes 256 observed words; LOAD also reads AUX 34, Q0 32, scale 2; largest RUN also reads activation 16 and writes 388 observed plus 2 out0 words. With one request/response per beat as a deliberately pessimistic no-redundant-transaction count, LOAD has at most 1160 adapter channel transfers, RUN 1458, rejection 1024, and the 24-command identity mode totals 25716. A one-entry adapter at its programmed 0..3 exposure delay needs at most five sampled edges from acceptance through delivery when its sink is immediately ready, giving 5800/7290/5120 and 128580 identity edge occupancies if channels were serialized. The chosen final R/B add 16 each in legal RUN. HLS ACT quantization has 8 groups with two four-block passes per group; scan and pack submodules report maxima 18 and 29 cycles per invocation, and the report submodule has 1134-cycle latency. Linear has 8 group/tile issue slots; HLS top and linear latency remain unknown, and endpoint/HLS backpressure can exceed the immediate-ready adapter calculation. Thus 20000/250000 are prior watchdogs to make failure finite, not proven latency or physical timing bounds; any timeout is a failure to investigate.

watchdog_review.independent_schedule_context: Read existing csynth XML/source: report1134 cycles, quant scan18 and pack29 per invocation, fixed8 groups, padded LOAD scale64 entries at up to53 nominal iteration clocks,8 linear group/tile slots, linear loop has generic variable latency. Read/write transfer counts in packet are finite fixture workloads. Adapter edge counts assume ready sink and are not end-to-end proofs. 20000/250000 are prior fail-stop watchdogs, not proven HLS or physical timing bounds.

snapshot_review.lookup: Fresh prepared/xsim.dir absolute symlink to compiled directory; xsim uses default lookup. No ambiguous -xsimdir path.
snapshot_review.requirements: These four exact paths are hashed and archived per mode before further source/snapshot comparisons, including failure. Every other snapshot file and new path must match the static binding manifest. No extension-wide exclusions.

boundaries: Source review only; reviewer did not run compiler, elaborator, simulator, HLS, oracle generator or fixture materializer.
No numerical RTL result, full-matrix coverage, subnormal/FTZ general proof, OOC, platform, board or50ms performance claim.
